summary: T7-03 round 2 passes. All five story checks ran and exited 0. The round-1 blocker (codex-r1-1) is fixed: page-check.ts now requires the mock banner, mode banner and footer to match as whole texts. The change adds no NuqsAdapter, and site-header.tsx is the only client module. I did not reproduce the gzip -9 initial-JS figure. The permission rules forbid piping, so that part of the last criterion is NOT_RUN. The author's 177,190 B figure is plausible and well under the 250 kB budget.

checks.evidence: ruff, mypy, eslint and typecheck all passed; turbo reported 4 successful tasks.
pytest: 404 passed. web vitest: 246 passed in 11 files, including page-check.test.ts (27) and site-layout.test.tsx (32). schema vitest: 157 passed. The web results were cache hits replaying the logs.
Route table shows ○ / and ○ /_not-found, both static, so / stays statically rendered with the layout.

checks.criterion: make web-smoke and the T0-05 assertions
checks.evidence: web-smoke: GET / (prerendered) shows the mock banner, "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)" and bundle version mock-0 in the footer.

checks.criterion: AC1 mode and mock banner texts
checks.evidence: mode-banner.tsx:10-21 matches the PRD 4 titles at PRD.md:168-170 word for word. The null mode reads "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 <status>)". The mock banner renders only when shellText gives non-null text (mock-banner.tsx:9-10). The 14 banner tests pass.

layout.tsx:28-38 renders, in order: SkipLink, header (MockBanner, ModeBanner, SiteHeader), main#main and SiteFooter. The mock banner has role="status" and carries its own text (mock-banner.tsx:12). The footer reads "Bundle version: <v> · Schema <schema_version>" (site-footer.tsx:9).

site-header.tsx:11-19 lists exactly the seven links as next/link, with no /api/docs, /paper, /probe or /compare. aria-current="page" is set only on an exact pathname match (line 32). The links are plain anchors in DOM order, and the focus ring comes from the global style; tests/site-layout.test.tsx covers this.
page.tsx:13-14 shows the title plus one factual line with no numbers or claims. The banners add only the PRD 4 title for a mode, with no radar-match or analog-result wording.

checks.criterion: AC6 and AC7 page-check update, exact protected texts, mock guard
checks.evidence: page-check.ts:86-119 requires the mock banner and mode banner as exact text runs, the footer as exact text, one mode line, and <main> equal to title + HOME_LINE. The Mock-bundle-on-real-bundle check is kept. lib/bundle.ts is not in the diff, so the production guard is untouched. The round-1 mutations (v10, BA, missing title, extra words) are covered by page-check.test.ts.

checks.criterion: AC8 client component scope and initial JS size
checks.evidence: site-header.tsx has 'use client'. The other new components have no directive, and layout.tsx and page.tsx are server components. Static rendering is confirmed by the build route table. I could not run the gzip -9 measurement because pipes and loops are forbidden. The author reports 177,190 B against the 173,974 B baseline and the 250 kB budget.

findings.claim: AC2 reads 'Bundle <bundle_version>', but the footer keeps T0-05's 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>' wording.
findings.evidence: The web-smoke output shows 'Bundle version: mock-0'. T0-05 requires that wording, so it is consistent with the existing assertions; it is a literal reading difference from AC2 only.

findings.claim: The initial-JS gzip -9 measurement was not independently reproduced.
findings.evidence: The command needs a shell loop or pipe, which the review permission rules forbid, so I could not run it.
